[shr-00001] When an object is visible on a surface, directly pick it up and move it to the target location without unnecessary intermediate steps.
[shr-00002] When an object is not mentioned in the task and is not necessary for reaching or handling the target object, avoid interacting with it to prevent unnecessary steps.
[shr-00003] When an object has already been searched for in a location and no trace of it was found, avoid revisiting that location unless new information suggests it might be there.
[shr-00004] When the target location is a receptacle and it is closed, open it before attempting to place the object inside.
[shr-00005] When the target object is not found in expected locations, search additional common locations such as countertops or the sink, as these are typical places for utensils.
[shr-00006] When a dirty version of the target object is found, clean it in the sink before placing it in the target receptacle, as the task requires a clean object.
[shr-00007] When the target object is not found in common locations like countertops or the sink, continue searching in additional receptacles and objects (e.g., unopened cabinets or drawers) before concluding it is not present.
[shr-00008] When the target object is found on a visible surface and requires cleaning, clean it immediately after picking it up before placing it in the target location, as this ensures task completion in one efficient sequence.
[shr-00009] When the target object is not found in common locations like countertops or the sink, prioritize opening and checking unopened receptacles (e.g., cabinets, drawers) before revisiting already opened or searched locations.
[shr-00010] When the target object has not been found in all expected and common locations (e.g., countertops, sink, unopened receptacles) and multiple redundant searches have yielded no results, consider the possibility that the object is not present in the environment and adjust the strategy accordingly (e.g., stop searching or attempt to complete the task with an alternative object).
[shr-00011] When a cleanable object is found on a visible surface, pick it up, clean it immediately in the sink, and then place it in the target receptacle after opening it, to ensure a single, efficient sequence of actions.
[shr-00013] When the task specifies that the target object must be 'cool', place the object in the fridge or freezer for a sufficient duration to cool it before proceeding with the placement in the target receptacle.
[shr-00025] When the target object is a vegetable (e.g., lettuce) and has not yet been found, check the fridge first before opening it, as vegetables are commonly stored there.
[shr-00027] When the target receptacle already contains a similar object (e.g., another tomato), proceed to place the target object in the receptacle unless the task explicitly prohibits multiple instances of the object. This avoids unnecessary delays or redundant checks when the task does not require exclusivity.
[shr-00030] When the task specifies the target object must be 'heated', open the microwave, place the object inside, and heat it before proceeding to the next step, ensuring the heating action is recognized before placement.
[shr-00035] When the task explicitly requires the target object to be 'heated', plan for the heating action as part of the task sequence, even before the object is found. This includes identifying and preparing access to the microwave in advance to ensure the heating step is not skipped or delayed.
## VERIFICATION CHECKLIST
[vc-00012] Verify that when a cleanable object is found on a visible surface, the agent executes a single, uninterrupted sequence of actions: pick up → clean → place in target receptacle, without unnecessary detours or intermediate steps.
[vc-00014] Verify that when the task specifies the target object must be 'cool', the agent cools the object (e.g., places it in the fridge) before placing it in the target receptacle.
[vc-00015] Verify that after cooling the target object in the fridge, the agent opens the target receptacle (e.g., garbagecan) before placing the object inside, ensuring all required conditions (coolness and receptacle openness) are met.
[vc-00016] Verify that when the target object is not found in common locations, the agent systematically opens and checks all unopened receptacles (e.g., cabinets, drawers) before revisiting already searched locations.
[vc-00017] Verify that when the target object is not found in common locations like countertops or the sink, the agent systematically opens and checks unopened receptacles (e.g., cabinets, drawers) only after exhausting all common surface locations.
[vc-00018] Verify that after multiple unsuccessful searches in already opened and empty locations, the agent stops searching those locations and instead considers the possibility that the target object is not present in the environment.
[vc-00019] Verify that when the target object is found on a visible surface and requires cooling, the agent follows a direct sequence: pick up → cool → open target receptacle → place in target receptacle, without unnecessary detours or intermediate steps.
[vc-00020] Verify that when the target object has not been found in all expected and common locations (e.g., fridge, countertops, unopened cabinets) and multiple redundant searches have yielded no results, the agent stops searching those locations and considers the possibility that the object is not present in the environment.
[vc-00021] Verify that after picking up the target object (e.g., egg), the agent places it in the fridge and waits for the cooling action to be recognized before proceeding to the next step (e.g., placing it in the microwave).
[vc-00022] Verify that when the target object is found and requires cooling, the agent follows a direct sequence (pick up → cool → open target receptacle → place in target receptacle) without unnecessary detours or intermediate steps.
[vc-00023] Verify that after placing the target object in the fridge for cooling, the agent waits for the environment to recognize the cooling action before proceeding to the next step (e.g., placing the object on the countertop).
[vc-00024] Verify that when the task specifies the target object must be 'cool,' the agent follows a direct and uninterrupted sequence: pick up → cool → place in target receptacle, without unnecessary detours or intermediate steps.
[vc-00026] Verify that after cooling the target object, the agent places it in the target receptacle (e.g., countertop) as the final step in the sequence, ensuring full task completion.
[vc-00028] Verify that when the target receptacle is a garbagecan and the object is to be placed inside, the agent opens the garbagecan before placing the object inside, ensuring compliance with the general rule of opening receptacles before use.
[vc-00029] Verify that when the target object is found on a visible surface and the task requires it to be 'cool', the agent does not skip the cooling step and instead follows the sequence: pick up → cool → open target receptacle → place in target receptacle.
[vc-00031] Verify that when the task specifies the target object must be 'heated', the agent follows a direct sequence: pick up → open microwave → heat → place in target receptacle, without skipping the heating step.
[vc-00032] Verify that when a receptacle (e.g., microwave) is already open and accessible, the agent does not unnecessarily close and reopen it unless the task explicitly requires such an action.
[vc-00033] Verify that after heating the target object in the microwave, the agent places it in the specified target receptacle (e.g., diningtable) as the final step in the sequence, ensuring full task completion.
[vc-00034] Verify that after multiple unsuccessful searches in all expected and common locations (e.g., fridge, countertops, unopened cabinets) and no trace of the target object is found, the agent stops searching and considers the possibility that the object is not present in the environment.
[vc-00036] Verify that when the target object is found on a visible surface and the task requires it to be 'hot', the agent follows the full sequence: pick up → open microwave → heat → open target receptacle → place in target receptacle, without skipping any steps even if the object is easily accessible.
[vc-00037] Verify that when the target object is found on a visible surface and the task requires it to be 'hot', the agent follows the full sequence: pick up → open microwave → heat → open target receptacle → place in target receptacle, without skipping any steps even if the object is easily accessible.
